# A style field that reads state, rendered by a real browser.
#
# html wrote a style literal's fields only when the build could read them, so a
# field reading state wrote nothing: not in the markup, not on first render and
# not after the state changed. testdata/html_style_reactive.txtar shows the
# writes the page now makes; this runs them, and reads the style back off the
# DOM as Chromium parsed it -- so a helper that produced text a browser refuses
# (a color it cannot parse, a length with no unit) shows up as a declaration
# missing from the element rather than as a passing grep over the source.
#
# Confirmed by reverting the html change: both snapshots then carry only the
# static `text-align: center`. A color held as a string and a dashed border
# beside a run-time width each broke that way too: the color helper threw on the
# string, aborting the rest of the writes, and borderWidth's fixed
# `border-style: solid` replaced the dashed one on every write.

# Chromium orders a calc()'s terms itself, hence 2em before 3px below.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

grep 'color: rgb\(255, 255, 255\)' app.sngl.snapshots/before.html
grep 'font-weight: normal' app.sngl.snapshots/before.html
grep 'padding: 0px' app.sngl.snapshots/before.html
grep 'width: 10rem' app.sngl.snapshots/before.html

grep 'color: rgb\(51, 51, 51\)' app.sngl.snapshots/after.html
grep 'font-weight: bold' app.sngl.snapshots/after.html
grep 'padding: 2px' app.sngl.snapshots/after.html
grep 'width: calc\(2em \+ 3px\)' app.sngl.snapshots/after.html
grep 'text-align: center' app.sngl.snapshots/after.html
grep 'background-color: rgb\(255, 0, 0\)' app.sngl.snapshots/after.html
grep 'border-style: dashed' app.sngl.snapshots/after.html
grep 'border-width: 2px' app.sngl.snapshots/after.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

output { none { html } }

component main node {
    var active = 0
    var tint = #ff0000

    button #flip(text="x", @click { active = 1 })
    text(value="y", style={
        color = active == 0 ? #ffffff : #333333,
        fontWeight = active == 0 ? normal : bold,
        padding = 2px * active,
        width = active == 0 ? 10rem : 3px + 2em,
        textAlign = center,
        background = tint,
        borderStyle = dashed,
        borderWidth = 1px + 1px * active,
    })
}

func testStyleFollowsState(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("before")
    c.flip.click()
    t.snapshot("after")
}

window {
    main
}
-- testrun/html/none/app.sngl/main/1 --

    {
      "Desc": "StyleFollowsState",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ],
  "snapshots": {
    "after.html": "",
    "before.html": ""
  }
}
